result: EXACTLY IDENTICAL oxygen model outputs in A/B/C
scope: Structural input ablation of the current implementation, not accuracy validation, causal inference or a test of all possible NISAR methods.
spatial_selection_caution: The fixed 26-location set was originally selected using radar candidates plus monitoring contexts. This is not a sensor-blind test population or a placement-benefit validation.
strongest_contribution: NISAR adds measured L-band changes for questioning physical explanations; it supplies no validated quantitative environmental constraint in this case.

reference_sensitivity.interpretation: Measured local changes and sensitivity to two assumed common offsets. Proxies are not invariant; residuals are not calibrated uncertainty bounds or water labels. No correction is applied.
reference_sensitivity.support: Local native centered 5x5 20m power mean, versus matched-grid 100m reference medians; footprints may differ by one native-pixel edge.

measurement_requirements.measurement: Retrieve a dated, georeferenced archived wet/dry/depth and canopy observation matching the studied interval; for a future repeat collect paired water-depth, soil-moisture and canopy observations at this fixed block.
measurement_requirements.why: This block has no validated radar-to-water label. NISAR adds a local HH/HV question in C, but not proof that this is the best place to sample.
measurement_requirements.basis: Fixed existing location and visible measurement gap; no optimal placement or validated decision improvement

measurement_requirements.purpose: Separate shared radiometry from environmental change
measurement_requirements.where: Stable reference targets spanning the scene; exact sites not established
measurement_requirements.measurement: Check invariant radiometric targets and full acquisition QA, alongside moisture observations. Built/bare land cover alone is insufficient.
